tone: Speak with patience and respect, acknowledging this is the fourth conversation on this topic and that he has asked for time, while gently underscoring the urgency given his age and health.
entry_point: Start with an update on the family property portfolio's performance and the goal of maintaining his lifestyle income, then transition into how a structure could protect that portfolio.
avoid: Do not lead with his declining health or the risk of forced asset sales upon his death, as this has already been raised repeatedly and he has asked for space to think.
